# Embla Carousel 8.6.0

Unmodified browser UMD builds from `embla-carousel@8.6.0` and
`embla-carousel-auto-scroll@8.6.0`, served locally without a build step or CDN.

- [Embla Carousel source](https://github.com/davidjerleke/embla-carousel/tree/v8.6.0/packages/embla-carousel)
- [Auto Scroll source and documentation](https://github.com/davidjerleke/embla-carousel/blob/v8.6.0/packages/embla-carousel-docs/src/content/pages/plugins/auto-scroll.mdx)
- Both packages use the included MIT [LICENSE](LICENSE).
